thread:
sam: Hi all, first week here. Accepted the org invite but when I try to push to 'redwood-inference/sdk' I get a 403. Invite said SSO + 2FA required. Not sure what I'm missing.
kevin: Welcome! Quick checklist: did you accept SSO on github.com (look for the purple banner), and is your local git using your work account? What command and full error?
sam: `git push origin feature/x` -> `remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed.` then `fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/': The requested URL returned error: 403`
kevin: GH006 can be branch protection (can't push to main), but 403+HTTPS often means SSO/identity mismatch. Do `ssh -T git@github.com` and `git config --get user.email`.
sam: `ssh -T` returns `Hi sam.personal!` and `git config user.email` is my personal email. Hmm.
marianne: Looks like your laptop is authenticating as personal. Two options: add a work SSH key to your work GitHub account, or update ~/.ssh/config to force using the work key for GitHub. Example: ```Host github.com
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_redwood
  IdentitiesOnly yes```
sam: I added a new key to my work account and switched SSH config. `ssh -T` now says `Hi sam.work!` Still can't push to main but I can push branches.\ev:devex: We enforce protected branches for repo main; direct pushes are blocked. Devs should open a PR. Also confirm your team mapping 1: if you need maintainer rights for that repo you'll need to be on the right team.
kevin: Right — I checked the org mapping, you were put into "sdk-read" only. If you need write access to merge, I'll add you to "sdk-maintainers". @sam want that?
sam: Yes please, I'll need to merge small runtime fixes.
kevin: Added you to sdk-maintainers. Wait ~2 minutes for GitHub to propagate.
onboard-bot: Reminder: org policy requires 2FA + SSO. If you have multiple GitHub accounts, use a work SSH key or SSH host alias. Onboarding doc: https://redwood-inference.internal/onboarding/github-setup
sam: After the team add I can create a branch and open a PR, and maintainers merged it. All good now, thanks folks!
marianne: Filing a tiny onboarding tweak: add explicit step in invite email to "verify your GitHub identity (work vs personal) and create a work SSH key / SSH config alias". @devex FYI.
